name: bit_on_rigid_carrier_v1
definition: T_marker_object maps object coordinates into marker coordinates. T_camera_object=T_camera_marker*T_marker_object.
marker_axes: X right on upright printed marker; Y up; Z out of printed face.
object_axes: Origin total-length midpoint; X toward tip/right on carrier; Y up on card; Z out of card.
mount_assumptions: Bit fixed flat in25x5 guide, face height4mm, center2mm above paper. Glue thickness, print error and placement error are unmeasured.
physical_status: Template prepared; user print, rigid fixing and physical motion test still required.
